[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed benefits of DIY skincare: customization, natural ingredients, cost-effectiveness, zero waste, fun and empowering.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed basic ingredients for DIY skincare: oils (coconut oil, olive oil, jojoba oil, sweet almond oil, argan oil), butters (shea butter, cocoa butter, mango butter), essential oils (tea tree oil, lavender oil, geranium oil), honey, clays (bentonite clay, kaolin clay, French green clay).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided simple DIY recipes:  
- Face Moisturizer: 1/2 cup coconut oil, 1/4 cup shea butter, 2 tablespoons honey, 2 drops lavender essential oil.  
- Exfoliating Scrub: 1 cup sugar, 1/2 cup coconut oil, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 2 drops tea tree essential oil.
